martha.name: Martha
martha.comment: Martha, Saturday morning is looking decent for a run, around 17°C and not too windy, especially between 6 and 8 am. You might want to drag Britt along for a ride later, but watch out for possible rain and gusts after 15:00. Running's your best bet today, so make the most of the early hours.

britt.name: Britt
britt.comment: Britt, running looks like the way to go today, especially early on - 06:00-08:00 is your best window with decent temps and relatively dry conditions. Might be a bit humid, but it's a great chance to get out before the possible rain kicks in later. If Martha's free, drag her along for a morning jog, and then you can both unwind with a drink on the terrace afterwards.
